about: External geometry beyond edges, vertices and flat faces (fcsketch.py --suite ext on FreeCAD, sketchcheck.mjs --suite ext on the page): each case is a Body of its own ("solid": the cylinder, r 5 about the origin padded 8 mm, Face1 its side, Edge3 its top circle; or the flipped half disc, MapReversed on XY padded 4 mm, Edge3 its arc at z = 0) with the case's sketch S on "support" moved by "offset". External Projection of a face that is not flat (hidden-line removal), External Intersection of a face and of an edge, a reference projected and then intersected (ExternalTypes Both), a projected arc FreeCAD keeps reversed with a line's start on its start. Construction mode is on around the external tools, so the geometry is reference geometry, as the part file has it.

cases.name: ext-hlr-cylinder
cases.about: The cylinder's side seen from the front: hidden-line removal gives its two outlines and its two circles edge-on (B-splines).

cases.name: ext-hlr-cylinder-top
cases.about: The cylinder's side seen from above: its two circles.

cases.name: ext-int-cylinder
cases.about: External Intersection of the cylinder's side with the XZ plane: two lines (clicks on a sketch that is not on XY are left out: the camera is set for XY).

cases.name: ext-int-cylinder-mid
cases.about: The cylinder's side cut half way up: one circle (the section's arcs fitted, fitArcs), a line's end put on it.

cases.name: ext-int-edge
cases.about: External Intersection of the top circle with the XZ plane: two points.

cases.name: ext-both
cases.about: The cylinder's side projected, then intersected: one reference, ExternalTypes Both, the section's lines after the projection's geometry.

cases.name: ext-reversed-arc
cases.about: The flipped half disc's arc projected: a circle about -Z, which FreeCAD keeps as a reversed arc; a line's start made coincident with its (counter-clockwise) start, Vertex3.
